test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Comprehension: Eight colleagues Tara, Ravi, Dina, Varun, Sia, Maya, Nisha, and Rina occupy an eight-floor office building, where the ground floor is 1 and the top is 8. Dina works on the lowermost floor. There are three floors between Dina and Rina. Tara works on the 4th floor. Two floors separate Tara and Ravi. Five floors are between Varun and Sia. Nisha is on an odd-numbered floor. One floor is between Maya and Varun.

Who works three floors below the person immediately below Ravi ?
solution:
Given: Eight colleagues (Tara, Ravi, Dina, Varun, Sia, Maya, Nisha, Rina) occupy an eight-floor building (Floors 1 to 8).

1) Dina works on the lowermost floor (Floor 1). Three floors are between Dina and Rina.

2) Tara works on the 4th floor. Two floors separate Tara and Ravi. Since Dina is already on Floor 1, Ravi must be on Floor 7.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
